teacher.collision_gate: all robot bodies, including nonadjacent same-arm contacts; model adjacent exclusions retained

physics_evidence.scope: 30 Hz sampled solver state, not substep extrema or calibrated real hardware forces
physics_evidence.combined_drive: qfrc_actuator + qfrc_applied; constraint and passive forces are separate

teacher.grasp_rotation_evidence: Object orientation relative to link6, compared with contact-anchor establishment; reported in privileged evidence only, without a calibrated acceptance threshold.
teacher.training_note: Training acceptance is determined only by the final closed-file dataset audit.
teacher.trajectory: C2 natural joint splines; unloaded joint-limit overshoot may use a collision-checked convex B-spline with exact endpoints and approximate interior knots; C3 time law and sampled derivative retiming; loaded overshoot may use the explicit pose-fidelity guarded convex profile
teacher.grasp_frames: measured object SE(3) relative to nominal object grasp frame

bounded_loaded_path.reference: original solved-IK pose polyline at the same path parameter
bounded_loaded_path.scope: additional sampled approximation only; IK and tracking errors are separate
bounded_loaded_path.collision_checks: original actual-curve robot and carried-object gates retained

tcp_limits.planning: FK translation and SO(3) sample speed retiming, all arm trajectory generators
tcp_limits.measured_gate: initial and every post-integration native TCP velocity; reject, never clip

grasp_approach_clearance.scope: sampled moving-arm distance to active non-target task objects during final pregrasp and contact approach; planned aperture; original other collision gates retained
grasp_approach_clearance.calibration: uncalibrated planning margin, not continuous-time clearance proof

finger_contact.scope: Per-arm finger material. Object/table coefficients remain governed by their own profiles and MuJoCo mixing rules. No per-target material switching or hardware calibration claim.

experimental_rim_grasp.scope:
Fresh full physical rollout with one change: an 8 mm deeper plate rim grasp.

No assumed grasp transform is injected. Actual slip, contacts and rotation are
measured, and the existing planner uses the actual held pose. Original dynamics,
quality gates and release policy remain unchanged. State-only experiment.
